verdict.rationale: EBANX's own docs claim merchants can track available balance, scheduled payouts, and settlement history in real time, and marketing mentions 'unified reconciliation'. That covers visibility into settlements but only as one-line summaries. There is no evidence of letting finance-ops configure the payout schedule, nor of a per-payout breakdown of charges, fees, and refunds. Missing for 10: user control over payout/settlement schedule, itemized per-payout composition (charges, fees, refunds, chargebacks), settlement report/API documentation, independent corroboration.
